description:
On the /fly route, the HUD velocity readout shows 'NaN km/s' for all outer-planet missions (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) throughout the entire flight

Expected: The HUD velocity readout displays a finite, physically plausible heliocentric speed in km/s for every mission destination

Acceptance criteria:
- HUD speed readout on /fly must never display 'NaN' for any mission — user-facing values must be finite numbers [code-invariant: NaN is an invalid state in any numerical display; the app must never surface NaN to the user]
- The speed derivation must compute the vis-viva semi-major axis from the mission's actual transfer orbit (from the mission's destination, not a hardcoded Earth→Mars value) [spec: heliocentricSpeed() docstring in $lib/orbital/fly-physics.ts:37: '@param aTransferAu — transfer-ellipse semi-major axis (AU)'. The current caller at src/routes/fly/+page.svelte:952 always passes (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU)/2 ≈ 1.262 AU for non-Moon missions regardless of destination]

Domain facts:
- Hohmann transfer semi-major axes for outer planets: Earth→Jupiter ≈ 3.1 AU, Earth→Saturn ≈ 5.25 AU, Earth→Uranus ≈ 10.1 AU, Earth→Neptune ≈ 15.55 AU, Earth→Pluto ≈ 20.25 AU (standard orbital mechanics — derivable from destination planet semi-major axes)
